reasons: Claimed status is compliant and no redline or comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the rendered paragraphs are unchanged from the originals.

The cited fee architecture is genuinely usage-based (fee per US$1 million actually traded, tiered volume bands in p0056–p0067), so it meets the MINCOMMIT preferred position of 'fees are for usage or ordered services only'.

The only 'floor' language (p0070) is measured by volume the Licensee actually records as traded, not by a committed volume, so it is not a take-or-pay, minimum or shortfall charge; tiered rates are volume discounts, which the rule expressly does not treat as commitments.
The $2,500/month support fee (p0086) and the initial payment are fees for ordered services, permitted by the preferred position, and the volume rebate runs in our favour, so no flag is warranted.

Rationale correctly parks the 36-month Initial Period / lack of convenience exit under the term-and-termination rule rather than double-flagging it here, consistent with the no-duplicate-flagging instruction.
